stem: What is a difference between the people who organized Endeavour's move in the selection "A Massive Mission" and the builders of the Grand Canyon Skywalk in the selection "DO Look Down!"?

options.label: F
options.text: Only the organizers of Endeavour's move were satisfied with the results of their efforts.

options.label: G
options.text: Only the organizers of Endeavour's move required help from engineers.

options.label: H
options.text: Only the builders of the skywalk made decisions based on concerns about public safety.

options.label: J
options.text: Only the builders of the skywalk were hoping their project would create jobs.
